The market took me back to European traditional markets because they fused history with modern life while maintaining a natural vibrant feel. The two locations function as vibrant eating and cultural spaces that welcome local and visiting populations. However, there are notable differences. La Boquería displays its Mediterranean charm through its grand iron structure alongside colorful displays of fresh seafood and fruits and Iberian delicacies. By contrast Strip District showcases an industrial rustic charm which exhibits worldwide international cuisine reflecting Pittsburgh's diverse immigrant roots. Face-to-face interactions prevail in the Strip District although La Boquería provides an established upscale atmosphere. Every market operates with its own distinct personality according to my observations.
